card.name: Partway to plural person nouns
card.fires_on: Responds just before a word that will end in a person-type plural such as -ians, -ans, -ists or -aries, mostly in the middle of words like PHYSICIANS or CLINICIANS. It also fires on words before nouns for kinds of people, like outlaws, liberals, hypocrites or stars.

modes.label: Inside capitalized professional titles
modes.description: Middle of an all-caps word for a clinician or group that will end in -IANS.
modes.example: WARNINGS TO PHYS<<ICI>>ANS Clinical Worsening and Suicide Risk

modes.label: Before a group-of-people noun
modes.description: A modifier or opening piece just before a noun naming a type of person.
modes.example: between economic conservatives and<< social>> liberals

card.writes: It favors endings like -ans and -sin and suppresses child and adult, so it pushes toward completing a person-type word.
card.plain: It fires when a word for a type of person, such as physicians or clinicians, is about to be completed.
